notes: Fictional sample campus for forks (docs/fork-data-guide.md). Every name is invented; the coordinates sit in Golden Gate Park, San Francisco, purely because that area has rich OSM basemap detail, so the seeded map looks sensible out of the box. Seed with `bun run seed:sample`.

buildings.name: Acacia Hall
buildings.directions: The main administration building, at the north edge of the central concourse. The registrar and student records are on the ground floor.

buildings.name: Banyan Science Complex
buildings.directions: South side of the central concourse, opposite Acacia Hall. Lecture hall BSC 1 is behind the main entrance; teaching labs are in the east wing.

buildings.name: Cedar Library
buildings.directions: West end of the concourse, past the bandshell. The audio-visual room (CL AVR) is on the second floor.

buildings.name: Dogwood Student Center
buildings.directions: Northeast of the concourse, by the main east path. Org spaces and the multi-purpose room DSC 12 are on the ground floor.

buildings.name: Elm Engineering Building
buildings.directions: Just south of Banyan Science Complex. Classrooms face the courtyard; the computing lab EEB LAB 1 is on the ground floor.

buildings.name: Fern Gymnasium
buildings.directions: Southeast corner of campus, next to the open courts. PE classes meet at the main court (FG COURT).

organizations.name: Evergreen Hiking Society
